body:
Decide whether to select one bounded native held-segment residual-learning comparison or retain no successor for SCDMP.

The source intake distinguishes full-return algebra, semi-gradient TD, two-endpoint sampled residual gradients and the existing VSPC1 gate. The candidate retains the complete MLP/Monte Carlo learner and tests only one additional residual penalty on naturally observed opening holds. No novelty, exact Bellman guarantee or unique duration causality is claimed.

Fixed source intake: https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/21a801279bd449c09907f5cf040efa693ae345a3/docs/research/candidates/semigroup_consistent_duration_model_policy/SCDMP_NATIVE_RETURN_COMPOSITION_P56_SOURCE_INTAKE_20260908.md

The D6 action-choice/countdown-search family remains parked. P56 currently authorizes one source question only; no card, learner, environment call or scientific invocation is selected. If selected by the proper node, the prospective comparison is one matched pair with the intact MLP reference and H, 286720 native steps, 2048 Adam calls, and original 1800-second per-arm / 3600-second logical-pair caps. Preserve all contrary evidence, including the newer UCOPE B02 losses and absence of tuned headroom.

The fixed TASK will authorize Pro to write only docs/research/candidates/semigroup_consistent_duration_model_policy/pro_packets/20260908_held_residual_convergence/archive/RESPONSE.md on codex/scdmp and post its immutable delivery link here. Source/code/main/direction-state changes and scientific execution are outside the Pro delivery scope. The DM will read the full immutable response for intake.
title: SCDMP: native held-segment residual learning
